summary: Royal Bank of Canada filed a 424B5 product supplement for Leveraged Index Return Notes (LIRNs), unsecured senior debt securities linked to the performance of underlying equity securities or a basket. The notes offer a multiple of positive performance with potential downside exposure below a Threshold Value, and may be capped. BofA Securities acts as agent in a principal capacity. No principal amount, pricing, or deal terms are specified; terms will be set in subsequent pricing supplements. This is a routine structured product shelf takedown, not a special situation.
